patthana16.95:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nasaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.95:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasanidassanasappaṭigho naaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.95:4.1: Sanidassanasappaṭigho araṇo dhammo nasanidassanasappaṭighassa naaraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana16.95:6.1: (Yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) Dhammānulomapaccanīye tikadukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
